body: Focused pagination review: ACCEPT the four v1 choices as the right conservative scientific baseline. Whitespace-only keeps the rule explainable; automatic hyphenation would introduce synthetic glyphs unless represented as a separate non-source mark; NBSP and NNBSP should remain non-breaking; widow/orphan control should wait until paragraph structure is an explicit typed input and policy, because it changes page identities. Two hardenings before calling the Codex pagination canonical: (1) the forced overlong-token fallback must cut at a grapheme cluster, not merely a Unicode code point, otherwise combining marks and ZWJ emoji can be split; a too-wide cluster can occupy one overflow line. (2) own a closed, versioned break classifier instead of Character.isWhitespace, whose Unicode/library behavior is not the declared contract across JVM and JS. Document this as breakable whitespace, with laws for ASCII space/tab and declared Unicode spaces, plus non-break laws for NBSP, NNBSP, figure space, word joiner, and soft hyphen. Strong audit addition: carry a typed BreakReason on each TextFragment (EndOfText, HardNewline, SoftWhitespace, ForcedCluster, OverflowCluster) and count reasons in the receipt. No code touched; I recommend a narrow follow-up bead so Gemini wiring need not overlap it.
